text: Android: app crashes on launch — LocalizedContent hid the Activity from hiltViewModel()

Fix verified properly: the regression test was run against the OLD
createConfigurationContext implementation and FAILED (GRADLE_EXIT_WITH_OLD_CODE=1),
then passed once the ContextThemeWrapper fix was restored. A regression test that
passes both before and after the fix would have been worthless here.

Shipped in 1.9.1. The v1.9.0 tag is being left in place rather than deleted: that
build was installed on a real device for release-testing, which is how the crash
was found, so 1.9.0 genuinely happened and the history should say so. Retagging it
would also have left two different builds sharing versionCode 13 — the phone would
not have seen the fixed build as an upgrade.

Follow-up on the coverage gap that allowed this: T-130.
